title: Odile and the Promise
author: Jonah Ishikawa
blurb: Wendell Coldharbour, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent five years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
